why: replace_all is modelled rather than ignored. Note what this case does NOT prove: every occurrence has the same line delta, so its SIGN never changes with the number of replacements — a shrink is a shrink at one occurrence or at ten. No fixture can distinguish the two models under a line-count rule, and deleting the replace_all branch would keep this suite green. It is kept because the branch becomes load-bearing the moment the check reads content instead of counting lines, and that is stated in configs/agent/README.md rather than implied by a passing test.
